'''Saeduree River Shipping''' was a shipping company based on [[Kinyen/Legends|Kinyen]] that was founded thousands of [[Standard year|years]] before the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. While most of the [[Planet/Legends|planet's]] businesses were nationalized by Kinyen's [[Socialism|socialist]] [[Tayan League|government]], Saeduree River Shipping was allowed to remain semi-private and was given exclusive shipping rights for much of [[Capra's continent]]. The company shared its name with one of Kinyen's [[Saeduree River|rivers]].<ref name="Strongholds" />

==Behind the scenes==
Saeduree River Shipping was mentioned in the [[2015]] ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]'' expansion ''[[Strongholds of Resistance]]'', which was published by [[Fantasy Flight Games]].<ref name="Strongholds" />
